quote: The Town agrees to provide health and life insurance in accordance with the PEC (Public Employees Committee) Agreement dated June 16, 2008 (attached).
basis: named in a union contract, and since 6 October 2026 held: received from the Town's HR Director (sources/contracts/pdf/pec-agreement-2008.pdf), whose page 1 and signature page are dated by hand the 16th of June 2008

quote: Tom's concern is that where we've adopted Section 19, he doesn't know at this point that he's just willing to scrap anything
basis: the Board speaking of §19 as already adopted — the acceptance vote itself is not in the record we hold

what: The town drafts a special act to take plan design out of bargaining
quote: Further, the Town of Lunenburg is also authorized to alter current and future plan design features, and that such action not be subject to collective bargaining as defined in M.G.L. Chapter 150E
basis: a DRAFT home-rule petition in the minutes. Whether it was filed, and what became of it, is not established here

quote: as of July 1st we'll be going to 75/25 of cost sharing split between the town and employees
basis: stated by staff to the Board on 1 March 2011, about the coming July

what: The Board is walked through the 2011 reform and what it could save
quote: Section 19-Public Employee Committee (PEC) · Health Insurance Reform · FY13 Estimated Costs · Maximum Possible Savings · Health Insurance Reform Available Options
basis: the agenda of a presentation. "Maximum possible savings" is the test §21(d) turns on. NO VOTE ADOPTING §§21–23 HAS BEEN FOUND, then or since

what: An amendment to the PEC agreement is dated
quote: The Town and the PEC agree to strike the language in paragraph 7 and paragraph 8 of the amendment dated May 14, 2013.
basis: named in later minutes; the amendment itself is NOT HELD

what: An agreement with the PEC is reported, to run until 30 June 2016
quote: Mr. Matthews noted that an agreement was come to with the Public Employee Union that helps contain health insurance costs. The agreement will last until June 30, 2016.
basis: stated to the Board; the agreement itself is NOT HELD. Whether it is the 14 May 2013 amendment or a separate document is not established

what: The 2013 amendment is itself amended: paragraphs 7 and 8 struck, a mitigation fund of $51,406 distributed
quote: The Town and the PEC agree that the Town, with the mitigation fund of $51,406.00, will provide a premium holiday or a one-deduction
basis: language read into the minutes; the signed amendment is NOT HELD

what: The Board approves a new PEC agreement effective 1 July 2022: Blue Select added, Part B moved from a percentage to a flat amount, an opt-out requested
quote: The new agreement starts July 1 and provides another health insurance plan option (Blue Cross Select). It provides a smaller network of providers and a lower cost. The agreement modifies Medicare Part B reimbursement from a percentage to a flat dollar amount.
basis: voted by the Board, All in Favor; the agreement itself is NOT HELD. Most likely the in-force agreement the FY27 memorandum amends -- inferred, not stated

what: The state tells municipalities how PEC agreements may set contributions
quote: The GIC reminds municipalities that it must be provided PEC agreements to the Commission under 805 CMR 801.
basis: GIC Administrative Bulletin 23-01. Our copy was pasted from a browser — mass.gov refuses this project’s fetches — and is a transcription until byte-verified
source: GIC Administrative Bulletin 23-01, Guidance Regarding PEC Agreements

what: A three-year memorandum of agreement takes effect, to 30 June 2029
quote: The Town and the PEC agree that the Town shall contribute 75% of the health insurance premium and the employee/Non-Medicare retiree shall contribute 25% of the health insurance premium for all active plans.
basis: the agreement itself, received by records request on 5 October 2026. It AMENDS "the current in-force health insurance agreement", which it does not attach. The signature page prints names and no date, so when it was signed is not established
source: Memorandum of Agreement between Town of Lunenburg and Lunenburg Public Employee Committee, effective July 1, 2026 – June 30, 2029
